en: The body is yellowish tinged with brown and the legs are paler. The minor soldier has an oval head one and a fifth to one and two-fifths times as long as wide, the fontanelle behind mid-length and the postmentum projecting below. Mandibles are slender, straight and pointed, more than two-thirds the length of the head capsule, the left finely toothed behind mid-length; antennae have 17 segments and the postmentum is a narrow band. The pronotum is shallowly excised on both margins and the hind tibia exceeds the head width.
soldier: 全体黄而带褐，足色稍淡。小兵头卵圆形，长为宽的一点二至一点四倍，囟在中点之后，侧观头背缘稍拱而后颏明显突出；上颚细长，长约达头壳的三分之二以上，颚端尖细而直，左上颚内缘自中点以后具细齿；触角十七节；后颏作狭条状，两侧近平行。前胸背板前后缘浅凹，前、后胸侧叶角状不显，中胸两侧近平行；后足胫节长于头宽。
